data.narrative:
Onodrim Industries is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Aistis Šimaitis, Alexander Blessing, and Christian Garrett, having raised €40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies spanning the defense & security sector—2 public firms (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methodologies apply here. Stage-progression analysis uses the €40M raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage step-ups, yielding €100M. Peer-median analysis examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Stark Defence (Series A, $4.0B), UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M). This peer set produces a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

These methods triangulate to a valuation range of $85M–$805M, with a median of $400M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around comparable stage definitions and sector growth multiples. The peer-median method skews high relative to stage-progression, driven by UFORCE's $1.0B Seed valuation and Stark Defence's $4.0B. Key uncertainties center on whether Onodrim's capital efficiency and market traction warrant premium relative to the lower end of the peer range.
